CUT-A-DOR — WEBSITE, INSTALLER & RECOVERY CREDITS

New Cut-A-Dor code: GPL-3.0-only. Device source: ../source.zip.
Website and installer source: ../source.zip.

FM-1 package reader and USB-MIDI updater:
Copyright (C) 2026 Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic), Hügelton Instruments.
GPL-3.0-only. Notices retained in install/fm1pkg.js and install/fm1ota.js.
https://github.com/kurogedelic/felucca
https://github.com/charlesvestal/fm1-x0x

Mac USB rescue: inherited fm1_rescue.py from the X0X project, GPL-3.0-only.
Boot protection and updater behavior are documented in the corresponding
Cut-A-Dor source. Open-source lineage is not an installation dependency:
the installation flow starts with M-VAVE Original and can return to Original.

Original FM-1 V15 binary: M-VAVE manufacturer firmware, included as manufacturer recovery material. No open-source license is asserted for it.
https://www.m-vave.com/download

Barlow Semi Condensed fonts: SIL Open Font License; notices in device source.
